title: Effective Horizons for Prophet Inequalities with Discounted I.I.D. Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2606.30118v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study prophet inequalities for $n$ i.i.d. base rewards subject to multiplicative discounts across $S$ phases. For equal-length phases and a common discount factor $\widetilde\gamma$, we characterize the optimal competitive ratio of single-quantile policies as $n\to\infty$ with $S$ and $\widetilde\gamma$ fixed. The resulting sharp guarantee describes the dependence on the phase parameters: it recovers $1-1/e$ without discounting and approaches $1/2$ in the worst-case regime. We also establish a distribution-free comparison that bounds the discounted prophet by a fractional i.i.d. maximum with effective horizon $B$, the sum of the discount weights across all observations. The comparison yields acceptance probability $1/B$, determined only by the phase profile. translated_title: 折扣独立同分布收益下先知不等式的有效视界
translated_abstract: 我们研究 $n$ 个独立同分布的基础收益在跨越 $S$ 个阶段承受乘性折扣时的先知不等式问题。对于等长阶段和共同的折扣因子 $\widetilde\gamma$，我们在 $n\to\infty$ 且 $S$ 与 $\widetilde\gamma$ 固定的情形下，刻画了单分位数策略的最优竞争比。由此得到的精确保证描述了对阶段参数的依赖关系：在无折扣情形下恢复 $1-1/e$，而在最坏情形下趋近于 $1/2$。我们还建立了一个无分布的比较结果，将有折扣的先知问题以有效视界 $B$（即所有观测折扣权重之和）界定为一个分数化的独立同分布最大值问题。该比较给出了仅由阶段结构决定的接受概率 $1/B$。这一校准即使在允许利用已知基础分布来选择接受概率的单分位数策略中，也能达到经典的最优保证。
tldr: 本文刻画了跨阶段乘性折扣下独立同分布先知不等式中单分位数策略的最优竞争比，并通过以折扣权重之和为“有效视界”$B$ 的无分布比较得出接受概率 $1/B$，达到经典最优。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the optimal competitive ratio of single-quantile policies for prophet inequalities with multiplicative discounts across phases, and establishes a distribution-free comparison with effective horizon $B$—the sum of discount weights—yielding an acceptance probability of $1/B$ that attains the canonical optimum.
